parent_objective: design config generation for L0 L1 L2 L3 profile smoke and later training without starting training
blocked_by: profile metadata exists but train and eval config generation is not yet specified
invalidates: starting profile training before generated configs are contract-checked

public_gates: M1189 may design config generation only
M1189 must not train controller weights
M1189 must not run candidate replay
M1189 must not use private holdout
M1189 must not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train L0 L1 L2 or L3
do not generate configs with hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim controller performance from config design

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: defines generated train eval and smoke configs for the controller-profile scaffold before implementation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training replay PPO promotion private-holdout driver-performance recurrent-belief or paper-result claim
stop_condition: stop if generated config design changes actor inputs
stop if finite-window profiles are omitted
stop if config design skips profile contract checks
fallback_plan: if train configs are too broad, design smoke-only generation first
if L2_window_100 is too large for initial smoke, keep metadata but mark training as staged
if current code cannot apply L0 mask at runtime, route to observation-mask wrapper implementation
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1188 scaffold is ready and needs generated config contract before training

admission_evidence: M1188 profile scaffold and tests pass
profile smoke confirms no hidden or oracle actor inputs
training remains blocked until generated configs are contract-checked
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: L0 mask runtime path is specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1189 is design only and should preserve L0 and L1 as current-frame substitution controls.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1189 should preserve finite-window steps from M1188 but does not evaluate them.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If config design cannot keep profiles comparable, route to profile scaffold repair before training.
allowed_claims: no self-identification, driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A generated config contract can keep L0/L1/L2/L3 controller smoke runs comparable and contract-clean before training starts.
success_criteria: train smoke config generation is specified
eval smoke config generation is specified
L0 runtime mask handling is specified
no controller training, candidate replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: design allows hidden or oracle actor inputs
controller training, candidate replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input change starts
decision_rule: M1189 passes if it defines the config generation contract and next implementation milestone without training or actor-input changes.
